name: Cloud of Needles, Mass Lesser
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level inquisitor 5, magus 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, summoner 5, witch 5

EFFECT

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 15)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser cloud of needles except it affects multiple targets and the damage is considered magical for DR purposes.
